## CreateRuntimeOptions.rateLimiter property

Admission limit applied per verified subject, after the credential is verified and before the permission check.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly rateLimiter?: RateLimiter;
```

## Remarks

Admission only turns calls away: a denied call raises `RateLimitedError`<!-- -->, and an admitted call still passes through every later step. A limiter that throws denies the call with `InternalError` (fail-closed), never with `RateLimitedError`<!-- -->, because the caller did not exceed a limit.
